name: chromatic-text-reveal
title: Chromatic Text Reveal
description: A sentence whose last word is painted in by a moving, colored edge, then swapped for the next.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text that stays put while the last word changes.

props.name: words
props.description: Words revealed one after another after the prefix.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the moving edge, any CSS color.

props.name: pause
props.description: Seconds a finished word rests before the next one.

props.name: loop
props.description: Goes back to the first word after the last one.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
